name: Shanghai Ocean Aquarium
tagline: Starter list: Shark Bay, then a green sea turtle and Pacific sea nettles — Magellanic penguins, not African.

practical.ticket_note: Lujiazui / Oriental Pearl area (Pudong) — not People’s Square.
practical.transit_note: Metro to Lujiazui; next to Oriental Pearl Tower.

bonus_hunt.tagline: Shanghai bonus · Shark Bay + tunnel turtle + nettles

challenges.text: Shark Bay: count the fins you can see at once.
Green sea turtle: flippers busy or a still float?
Pacific sea nettle: watch one pulse from top to bottom.
Big-belly seahorse: tail wrapped or swimming free?
